name: TiVo
title: Was TiVo too early? No: operators bundled their own DVRs
question: Was TiVo too early for digital video recording?
answer: TiVo launched the consumer DVR in 1999 and defined the category, but cable and satellite operators bundled their own DVRs into set-top boxes, and TiVo sold itself to Rovi in 2016. It was on time for DVRs; the operators controlled distribution. That is capture, not timing.
verdict_reason: Cable and satellite operators bundled DVRs and controlled distribution.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.

graveyard.name: TiVo
graveyard.how: Acquired by Rovi for about $1.1B in 2016
